name: Shadow of Paris
source:
Paris is a nursing student trying to cope with the loss of her mother, a distant father, and the pressure of school. Her life is already fragile—until one night, she realizes someone has been following her.

The stranger soon reveals himself as her charismatic professor. What begins as unease turns into fixation and fear. Is he watching over her, manipulating her, or something far more dangerous?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4238280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
帕丽斯是一名护理专业的学生，​​她努力应对失去母亲、疏远父亲的痛苦以及学校的压力。她的生命本来就脆弱——直到一天晚上，她意识到有人一直在跟踪她。

这个陌生人很快就表明自己是她魅力十足的教授。一开始的不安变成了固执和恐惧。他是在监视她、操纵她，还是做更危险的事情？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4238280/]Steam[/url]]
